metadata.short_desc: Use your ChatGPT subscription in AstrBot without an API key.
metadata.desc: Sign in via local Codex or device code, manage multiple accounts, check quotas, and enable automatic fallback.

providers.title: Providers
providers.description: Manage ChatGPT accounts, routing settings, and subscription quotas.

codex_auth_path.hint: Defaults to $CODEX_HOME/auth.json or ~/.codex/auth.json. In Docker, mount the directory with write access. Reload the plugin after changes.

chat_language.hint: Language for command replies and chat errors. The plugin page follows the dashboard language. Reload the plugin after changes.

image_enabled.hint: Generate images in chat or with /draw, or attach one image with instructions to edit it.

image_account.hint: Leave blank to use the current chat account. Set an account ID to restrict image generation to turns handled by that account.
